proof: Independent uniform cut coordinates have constant joint density on the unit square. With sorted cuts x<y, all pieces are <1/2 exactly when x<1/2, y>1/2 and y-x<1/2. This is one triangle of area 1/8; reflected order gives another. Equality boundaries have probability zero. Triangle inequality is equivalent to longest piece < half the total.
limits: Numerical checks supplement the stated general proof. No audience learning is inferred.
